description: Every instance cited is real: she did object, she did email, she was short in that meeting. The cause is absent from every account.
energy_note: All of it happened. None of it is why.

description: Once the label exists, further objection confirms it and silence is taken as acknowledgement.
Sectors are small, and the characterisation moves by conversation rather than by reference.
energy_note: It arrives before her CV does.
